name: product-manager-skills
description: Sixteen focused product-management skills for strategy, product judgment, discovery, research, design, UX audits, planning, and delivery handoff.

interface.shortDescription: A focused product-management toolkit for Cogine.
interface.longDescription: Sixteen curated skills for product strategy, product judgment, discovery, research synthesis, competitive analysis, PRDs, prototypes, roadmaps, metrics, product-interface design, principle-driven UX audits with visual evidence, implementation-ready specs, and tickets. It combines Cogine workflows with lightweight Matt Pocock skills, two high-quality design systems, and two focused Lenny product skills.
defaultPrompt: Define a clear product strategy and stress-test its key choices.
Apply a product-taste review before turning this idea into a PRD.
Synthesize this research and update the product roadmap.
Prototype three product-interface directions for this workflow.
Audit this product's UX against intuitive design and show the 3–5 worst issues with screenshots or schematics.
